TextConsoleMessageContent:
You are at the stream, you can peek at your reflection
**Images**:
- **Count Drops**: shows the drops you have gathered
- **Divination**: access the mountain peak.
TextMerchantMessageContent:
Merchants manage the abundance of drops midstream, where the bustling roar of the market veils heaven’s favour in thick industrious fumes. As a bridge between townsfolk and their rulers, merchants must maintain the balance of power. Although you may gather more  drops than your emperor, you must not forget your common role in service to those upstream.

**Duties:**
- **Bribe**: Gives drops to any person in Griefhem.
- **Endow**: Invest your drops in servile townsfolk, both of you gain more drops for a limited about of time.
TextPeasantMessageContent:
You’ve attained humanity upstream. As a free serf, you may wander the farm and the market.  The ebb and flow of service has placed you amongst your peers. Rile each other up, partake in this dutiful fervour by protecting the city from subhuman scum and maintaining its residents by open vote. Beware of forest further downstream where deranged scoundrels meddle with subhumans.  In this vast land, imperial knights live to fulfill their noble master’s wishes, and your life is downstream of their whims. The earth has bubbles, as the water has, and these are of them. Heaven’s favor ripples and gathers through the stream. It might lie downstream where the spray of revolution fills the eyes of the meek, such is revealed the hidden service of the Two Gods.

**Duties:**
- **mob flaying**: vote to kill a peasant or subhuman.
- **revolution**: by the Two Gods, you may overthrow all false order and restore divine servitude. Pick a target to begin a revolution.

**Duties:**
- **Swarm**: 4 Flies can gather to infest a sub-human, killing it.
- **Infanticide**: Flies can eat maggots, naturally.
TextMaggotMessageContent:
Wisps of excremental agency writhe within the puparium. You have spawned far beneath the stars. Your tiny body secretes bile as you squirm in the rot along the sewer’s slack stone, blindly burrowing toward a rapturous buzzing.

**Duties:**
- **Fester**: Chew into a poop to gain part of their drops.
TextEmperorMessageContent:
You spring forth as Heavens Favor Incarnate. In this emptiness, great sorrow befits all Emperors and the suffrage of the Two Gods becomes everclear, no longer lost in the confusion of their service that graces those downstream. The throne room glistens dully. Townsfolk commune over your body of rule. Dreams of legacy sprout within stagnation. The fall seduces you as the Gods restlessly await the turning of the tide.

**Duties:**
- **coronation**: Name a worthy vessel King.
- **Dethrone**: release a king from bondage, granting him lordship.
- **Heir succession**: Place your curse upon one of unfortunate debt.
- **Divination**: access to the mountain peak.
TextKingMessageContent:
You have been crowned King amongst Kings of the Royal Castle. As the first vessel to Heaven’s Favour your previous forms fade. The world downstream is knots away and the weight placed upon you saturates your being. The spring of service trickles downstream, and it is through you that it clots and dilutes. Knighthood is the will of Kings, it ebbs and flows in and out of its retainers. Kings are the only ones worthy of communion with the Emperor.  Pure as they may be, this distance often corrupts the uttering of the Two Gods, thus distributaries quarrel - Kings fall to Kings and in these bouts the roars of divine servitude ring through Griefhem.

**Duties:**
- **Degradation**: Show mercy to stagnant knights by demoting them to Merchant.
- **Knight**: Adorne the royal castle with worthy retainers, such honors are never forgotten.
- **Siege**: Rally loyal knights against a false King.
- **Royal Writ**: Order a Knight to execute anyone downstream, townsfolk or royalty.Such writs are of high ordonance, bountiful in drops and second only to Imperial writs.
TextLordMessageContent:
Your  servile nature has landed you in the Royal Castle. On your journey upstream you have shed sceptical intentions and find yourself in honest communion. Lords guide the ebb and flow upstream, they work in perfect kinship to vote future kings and Lords into their roles through the Great Council. One God plummets as One ascends, so too, Lords maintain their likeness by election, execution and exile.

**Duties:**
- **Exile**:Rid the townsfolk of scorched scoudrels.
- **Eminent writ**: Order a Knight to execute someone downstream(Peasant, Scholar, Merchant, Noble) in exchange for an arbitrary amount of drops.
- **Great council election**: Summon your fellow Lords to raise a noble amongst your rank or crown a new King from amongst you.
TextNobleMessageContent:
Nobles are a pitiful elite, neither trusted by the knights below nor adored by the royalty above. They may carry writs—”high” writs. Morally dubious and lacking in faith, they are handed a divine role which they fumble with a kind of earnest incompetence. Such stagnant types conspire against Royalty, hoping to sway Heaven’s Favour.

**Duties:**
- **high writ of execution**: Order a Knight to execute a townsfolk (Peasant, Scholar or Merchant)  in exchange for an arbitrary amount of drops.
- **assasination**: Not all power is seized in the light,  Initiate a plot against a marked target (Knight,Noble or Lord), swift and without public writ. If 2 more nobles join it is successful, but failure? Failure lingers under the eye of those upstream.
TextKnightMessageContent:
You have been bestowed knighthood. A path of ascension upstream, guided by the ancient ways and their keepers above. You have gained their courtesy. As sword of Griefhem you must maintain Heaven’s Favor and obey your masters by order of rank and rank alone. Nobles, Lords, Kings and Emperors will issue writs demanding executions, it is your duty to carry out these writs, if you fail a writ might be issued for your name. You are a vessel of servitude, an embodiment of imperial rule. The barracks are the central command for all Knights. Rivalries, guilds and righteous plots to overthrow corruption all sprout from this crucible of strength. Faced with such fortune many shortsighted knights face peril in the tapestry of upstream politics.

**Duties:**
- **Cut Down**: execute townsfolk, 0 drops if you have a writ for the target.
- **Coup**: Gather fellow knights and rise against the stillness of tyranny, taking down targeted royals, if the emperor is slayed, knights may gather to vote for a martial Emperor.
- **Oath**: Knights must obey their writs to maintain Heaven’s Favor.
TextPoopMessageContent: Pu, the vileness on the streets is you. You were once a crucible of life, now shunned into the abyssal depths of human cunning, the sewers. The stagnant water that you desolately plop in feeds festering vermin.
TextRatMessageContent:
You are birthed! What exaltation of flesh. As rats, we hold up heaven’s favor, which is entrusted to us through the plague. We all got the plague, lots of it. In our gathered mass we muster strength. Our vile agitation imitates the downstream swaths, deep beneath the Sewers.

**Duties:**
- **Plague**: Overturn the world above. When enough rats come together, chosen Sub-Humans, Peasants, Scholars, Merchants and Knights fall ill. Blight leaves the world above in divine communion, only then order is found in the matters of man.
- **Nibble**: Peckish rats may feed on flies and maggots.
TextScholarMessageContent:
Although the Emperor rules in constant divination, scribes may obtain temporary insight to the mountain peak, as The Two Gods favour the observant. Scribes watch over the stream, and may read all messages throughout Griefhem. It is their duty to maintain our servitude by sharing or withholding their insight in official correspondence with the royal castle.

**Duties:**
- **dove eye**: scribe can read messages across all Griefhem channels.
- **mystic/divination**: timed reading access to mountain peak.
- **advisor**: write a message to the royal castle.
TextSubhumanMessageContent:
Subhumans straddle the line, although present in the starlit forest, they prefer creeping below manholes, on the rim of the sewers. They facilitate anyone with ambitions in the underworld. Those above are wary of them as they know their true nature:  beasts known to feed on their own kind. Even in shunning, Subhumans curry favour to find their place in the world.

**Duties:**
- **Depravity**: kill a sub-human.
- **Manhunt**: frenzied Sub-humans can take a wandering peasant’s life but such acts go against Heaven’s favour.
- **Pickings**: Chomp chomp, splish splash, eat a maggot or a rat.
